{{Top|leg}}
'''Thrust-vector controls''' were components of the [[J-77 "Event Horizon" sublight engine/Legends|J-77 Event Horizon]] [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]]. The controls were adjustable, allowing the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] enhanced performance in flight. The controls were also connected to the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizer]] wing, allowing them to visibly adjust during [[Realspace/Legends|space]] flight.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
